AlertFiresAssertion.description:
Assert that at least one tick fires insufficient_reserve_alert.

Existential quantifier: a retained tick can satisfy it despite gaps.

retained tick fired but gaps exist — a dropped tick may have fired.

ClusterGenConfigSpec.description:
Configuration for the LLM-driven cluster arrival process generator.

When present on a ScenarioSpec, the generator is called ONCE at run start
(before the tick loop).  The resulting STARTING/JOB_END/SCALE events are
merged into spec_data["workload_events"] before the RunContext is built.

use_llm=True (default) calls Mistral for temporal structure — bursts,
business-hours patterns — that a Poisson process cannot reproduce.
Falls back to seeded RNG when MISTRAL_API_KEY is absent or the call fails.

use_llm=False forces the seeded RNG path.  Prefer this when the arrival
statistics are fully specified by the other fields (the Poisson case).

DqInjectEvent.description:
A scripted data-quality tag injection window.

Activates ``tag`` (a DataQualityTag value string, e.g. ``"invalid_payload"``)
for every tick where ``start_s <= sim_time < end_s``.  The effect is identical
to the tag firing naturally: the confidence band widens and the low-confidence
interlock blocks autonomous curtailment.

Multiple windows may overlap; each is additive.
Validated tag strings: unmapped_hardware, uncalibrated_site, invalid_payload,
stale_profile, workload_signal_stale, workload_signal_absent.

start_s.description: Sim-time (seconds) at which the tag becomes active.
start_s.title: Start S

end_s.description: Sim-time (seconds) at which the tag clears (exclusive).
end_s.title: End S

DqInjectEvent.title: DqInjectEvent

GenerationBlock.description:
Metadata record for all pre-run generators that ran for a scenario.

Stored on RunContext and emitted in run metadata so that a scenario
definition and a materialised spec are distinguishable artifacts.
A run ID + generation_block is sufficient to replay any run exactly:
- physics/RNG paths replay from seed alone.
- LLM paths replay by re-running the generators (Mistral may vary) or by
  reading the stored event lists from the scenario spec.

Fields
------
seed              : master RNG seed for this run (None = time-seeded).
generated_at      : ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when generation ran.
generators_used   : list of generator names that actually ran.
solar_source      : "mistral" | "physics" | "none".
cluster_source    : "mistral" | "rng" | "none".
stressor_source   : "mistral" | "rng" | "none".
param_sampler_note: human-readable summary from param_sampler.
corruption_note   : human-readable summary from telemetry_corruption.
GenerationBlock.title: GenerationBlock

KubeConfigSpec.description:
Kubernetes gang-admission demand simulator configuration.

When present on a ScenarioSpec, the simulator replaces the scripted
workload-event path with a discrete gang-admission simulator that models
steps 1–2 of the Kubernetes-to-turbine path:

  1. OBSERVE:  Poisson-arrival jobs enter a 10-second reorder buffer,
     simulating an in-cluster informer watching Kueue/Volcano objects.
  2. MAP TO CONTRACT: Each admitted gang emits a WorkloadSignal with
     node_count and hardware_profile_id.  Steps 3–8 (P_compute formula,
     thermal lag, BESS arbitration, turbine ramp) run unchanged in the
     scheduler-agnostic core pipeline.

dt_lead = 0 throughout — Kubernetes gives no advance notice to the grid.

Use rng_seed for deterministic replay; rng_seed=None gives time-seeded variety.
Activate stochastic step timing by supplying step_config; activate the
within-step load profile by supplying load_config.

min_nodes.description: Idle-baseline nodes — cluster never fully drains
min_nodes.title: Min Nodes

mean_interarrival_s.description: Mean simulated seconds between successive gang admissions
mean_interarrival_s.title: Mean Interarrival S

max_job_nodes.description: Per-job scheduling-unit ceiling. When omitted, the legacy max_nodes/2 fallback is used.
max_job_nodes.title: Max Job Nodes

reorder_window_s.description: Events drain from buffer after this many sim-seconds

ntp_jitter_s.title: Ntp Jitter S

MaintenanceConfigSpec.description:
Wire-format config for §27 prescriptive maintenance (MaintenanceLayer).

Gates whether a MaintenanceLayer is instantiated in the run context.
The layer calls reserve_contribution_mw_per_s() (TC-58), validate_window()
(TC-59), and propose_rating_change() (TC-60) during live runs.

ParamSamplingConfigSpec.description:
Configuration for per-run seeded RNG parameter sampling (§6.1 sensitivity).

When present, draws the listed physics parameters from their documented
[min, max] ranges once at run start and merges them into spec_data.

The seeded RNG path is always used — there is no LLM call here.  Seeded RNG
is the correct tool: the sampling distribution is fully specified by the
parameter ranges and there is no temporal structure an LLM adds value to.

keys  — parameter keys as in gridsignal_parameters.json (e.g. "alpha_max").
        Keys not in the adjustable list or in the _NEVER_SAMPLE exclusion set
        are silently skipped.
seed  — RNG seed; None = time-seeded (non-reproducible).
sample_plant_split — if True, split parameters draw independent plant and
        engine values, producing natural plant/engine divergence.

keys.description: Parameter keys to sample from gridsignal_parameters.json
keys.title: Keys

ParamSamplingConfigSpec.title: ParamSamplingConfigSpec

StressorGenConfigSpec.description:
Configuration for the LLM-driven fault and stressor timeline generator.

When present on a ScenarioSpec, the generator is called ONCE at run start
and its output (SOLAR_STEP events) is merged into spec_data["workload_events"].

The LLM composes plausible compound fault sequences: cloud front arrives,
inverter trips 90 seconds later, partial recovery — the correlated-failure
case that a hand-written scenario library under-represents.

use_llm=False forces the seeded RNG fallback (random cloud fronts).
StressorGenConfigSpec.title: StressorGenConfigSpec

TelemetryCorruptionConfigSpec.description:
Configuration for the pre-generated telemetry corruption schedule.

When present, a per-tick corruption manifest is generated ONCE at run start
from a seeded RNG.  The manifest specifies which ticks receive Gaussian noise,
dropout (record suppressed), or staleness (old reading substituted).

This exercises the §17.2 quarantine path, NTP-skew handling, and out-of-order
delivery logic.  All values default to 0.0 / 0 (no corruption) so that adding
the block without setting values is a safe no-op.

noise_sigma.description: 1-sigma of multiplicative Gaussian noise on readings (e.g. 0.05 = ±5%)
noise_sigma.title: Noise Sigma

dropout_prob.description: Per-tick probability of record suppression (packet loss)
dropout_prob.title: Dropout Prob

max_stale.description: Maximum staleness in ticks (0 = no staleness injection)
max_stale.title: Max Stale

TelemetryCorruptionConfigSpec.title: TelemetryCorruptionConfigSpec

TenantWorkloadEvent.description:
A scripted GPU burst job assigned to a specific colo tenant.

Contributes tdp_mw = gpus × 0.0007 MW to p_compute_demand_mw during the
window [t_start, t_start + duration_s).  Validated against
TENANT_CONTRACTED_MW at save time — the scenario is rejected if a single
event's TDP would exceed 150 % of the tenant's contracted power ceiling.
Overage (draw above 100 % of ceiling) is billed at +50 % per MWh on top
of the standard rate and is accumulated in SimulationState.tenant_overage_mwh
during the run.

tenant_id.description: Tenant ID ('a'–'e' for catalogued tenants, or a custom string).
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

scheduler.description: Scheduler name for display ('Slurm', 'Kubernetes', 'Ray', or null).
scheduler.title: Scheduler

gpus.description: Number of H100 SXM5 GPUs allocated.
gpus.title: Gpus

TenantWorkloadEvent.title: TenantWorkloadEvent

TurbineUnitSpec.description: One turbine unit within a scenario's fleet.
TurbineUnitSpec.title: TurbineUnitSpec

WorkloadEventSpec.description:
One scripted workload event (GPU job or renewable step) within a scenario.

event_type must be a WorkloadEventType string value:
  "starting"   — GPU job ramp begins; staging fires with dt_lead_seconds.
  "job_end"    — GPU job finishes.
  "solar_step" — Renewable curtailment; staging fires with dt_lead=0 (§7.1.1).
  "unit_trip"  — Force a generating unit offline immediately (TC-84/G-2).
                 job_id carries a turbine or fuel-cell asset_id. For a
                 block fuel-cell array, electrical_group_id optionally
                 addresses one declared group; omission trips the array.
                 node_count and hardware_profile_id are ignored.
  Any other WorkloadEventType value is forwarded as-is.

For solar_step events job_id, node_count, and hardware_profile_id are
ignored by the runtime; renewable_shortfall_mw carries the staging delta.
WorkloadEventSpec.title: WorkloadEventSpec

description:
Full scenario configuration.  Stored as spec_json in ScenarioRecord.
Posted to POST /scenarios or PUT /scenarios/{id}.

irradiance_steps convention — zero-order hold ("value applies from t
onward"): [(0.0, 1.0), (30.0, 0.0)] gives 1.0 for t<30 and 0.0 for
t≥30.  The last sample's value applies for all time beyond it.

dt_lead_seconds.description: Advance warning time for GPU job starts (seconds).  SOLAR_STEP events always use dt_lead=0 regardless of this value (§7.1.1).
dt_lead_seconds.title: Dt Lead Seconds

fuel_cell_rated_mw.description: Nameplate MW rating of ONE fuel cell stack. The physics engine and EDL use fuel_cell_rated_mw × fuel_cell_stack_count as the fleet-total available capacity. Example: 5 MW/stack × 4 stacks = 20 MW fleet.
fuel_cell_rated_mw.title: Fuel Cell Rated Mw

fuel_cell_initial_state.description: Initial thermal state for the aggregate fuel-cell array. When omitted for an enabled scenario, defaults to running.
fuel_cell_initial_state.title: Fuel Cell Initial State

fuel_cell_baseload_target_mw.description: Fixed aggregate fuel-cell baseload target in MW when load-following is disabled. When omitted, defaults to the full fleet nameplate.
fuel_cell_baseload_target_mw.title: Fuel Cell Baseload Target Mw

fuel_cell_load_following.description: When true, the running fuel-cell array follows live net site demand instead of holding the fixed baseload target.
fuel_cell_load_following.title: Fuel Cell Load Following

fuel_cell_ramp_rate_mw_per_s.description: Aggregate fuel-cell output ramp rate in MW per simulated second.
fuel_cell_ramp_rate_mw_per_s.title: Fuel Cell Ramp Rate Mw Per S

fuel_cell_ramp_down_rate_mw_per_s.description: Aggregate fuel-cell ramp-down rate in MW per simulated second. When omitted, uses the ramp-up rate.
fuel_cell_ramp_down_rate_mw_per_s.title: Fuel Cell Ramp Down Rate Mw Per S

fuel_cell_min_stable_fraction.description: Minimum stable output as a fraction of aggregate nameplate.
fuel_cell_min_stable_fraction.title: Fuel Cell Min Stable Fraction

design_peak_load_mw.description: Declared design peak site load (MW). Definition: peak_it_load_mw (node_count × rated_kw × PUE_base / 1000) + rated_cooling_mw (alpha_max × peak_it_load_mw × cooling_margin). Optional — old specs without this field load with a fallback derived at run start from workload_events and hardware_profile. Broadcast on TickPayload so fleet panels can use the declared figure for N−1 checks instead of the observed run maximum.
design_peak_load_mw.title: Design Peak Load Mw

irradiance_steps.description: Zero-order-hold irradiance profile. Duplicate timestamps unnecessary.
irradiance_steps.title: Irradiance Steps

gpu_load_profile.description: Zero-order-hold GPU load profile. Each tuple is (sim_time_s, non-negative load multiplier), where 1.0 is nominal full load and values above 1.0 model a planned GPU over-peak. Empty = constant 1.0. The active multiplier scales p_compute_demand_mw each tick so operators can shape GPU utilisation over time.
gpu_load_profile.title: Gpu Load Profile

workload_floor_fraction.description: Minimum compute load as a fraction of peak (0.0–1.0). When set, p_compute_demand_mw never falls below workload_floor_fraction × peak_compute_mw. None = no floor (default, backward-compatible).
workload_floor_fraction.title: Workload Floor Fraction

grid_import_limit_mw.description: Maximum real-power import at the point of common coupling (MW). None = unlimited grid balancing. Applies only when island_mode is false; exports are not capped.
grid_import_limit_mw.title: Grid Import Limit Mw

bess_normal_dispatch_depth_fraction.description: Fractional BESS depth of discharge permitted in normal operation, measured from each unit's configured initial SoC. Once used, the remaining BESS charge is held for an emergency that fuel-cell capacity plus available grid import cannot cover. 0 = historical BESS-first dispatch with no operating reserve.
bess_normal_dispatch_depth_fraction.title: Bess Normal Dispatch Depth Fraction

frequency_nominal_hz.description: Nominal grid frequency for the site (Hz).  60 Hz for WECC/ERCOT (North America); 50 Hz for EU/APAC. Drives the swing-equation denominator and all frequency-response criteria.
frequency_nominal_hz.title: Frequency Nominal Hz

uf_warning_hz.description: Under-frequency advisory threshold (Hz).  Below this frequency the advisory system alerts but the island does not collapse.  IEEE 1547-2018 Cat I / SDG&E default: 59.5 Hz.  None = threshold disabled (legacy scenario compatibility).
uf_warning_hz.title: Uf Warning Hz

ufls_stage1_hz.description: Stage-1 under-frequency load-shedding threshold (Hz).  Below this frequency automatic load shedding begins.  IEEE 1547-2018 Cat I / SDG&E default: 58.5 Hz.  None = UFLS stage 1 disabled.
ufls_stage1_hz.title: Ufls Stage1 Hz

island_collapse_hz.description: Island collapse (mandatory under-frequency trip) threshold (Hz).  Below this frequency the island de-energises.  IEEE 1547-2018 Cat I / SDG&E default: 57.0 Hz.  None = UF collapse disabled.
island_collapse_hz.title: Island Collapse Hz

of_warning_hz.description: Over-frequency advisory threshold (Hz).  Above this frequency the §INV-CURT inverter curtailment ramp begins.  IEEE 1547-2018 Cat I / SDG&E default: 60.5 Hz.  None = OF advisory and inverter curtailment disabled.
of_warning_hz.title: Of Warning Hz

of_trip_hz.description: Over-frequency trip threshold (Hz).  Above this frequency the island collapses via OF protection; inverter curtailment saturates at 100 % here.  IEEE 1547-2018 Cat I / SDG&E default: 62.0 Hz.  None = OF trip disabled.
of_trip_hz.title: Of Trip Hz

ufls_stages.description: Under-frequency load-shedding relay stages.  Each entry: {'threshold_hz': float, 'delay_s': float, 'block_fraction': float}. PROVISIONAL-UNMEASURED. None = UFLS disabled (default).
ufls_stages.title: Ufls Stages

relay_81u_threshold_hz.description: Islanded 81U under-frequency relay trip threshold (Hz). PROVISIONAL-UNMEASURED. None = 81U relay disabled (default). 57.5 Hz is the PROVISIONAL value for 60 Hz (WECC) systems.
relay_81u_threshold_hz.title: Relay 81U Threshold Hz

relay_81u_delay_s.description: 81U relay time delay before trip (s). PROVISIONAL-UNMEASURED. None = use catalogue default (0.10 s).
relay_81u_delay_s.title: Relay 81U Delay S

power_factor.description: Rated power factor of the synchronous generator fleet (dimensionless).  Converts rated_mw to MVA base: S_base = Σ rated_mw / power_factor.  Typical gas turbine: 0.85 (CHOSEN — calibrate against nameplate or vendor data).  Raising pf toward 1.0 lowers S_base and increases df/dt; lowering it slows frequency response.
power_factor.title: Power Factor

default_playback_speed.description: Default simulation playback speed for this scenario.  0 = run as fast as possible; >0 = simulated-seconds per real-second.  Stored in the spec so the operator's choice persists across sessions.
default_playback_speed.title: Default Playback Speed

dt_thermal_seconds.description: Engine value: thermal-delay before cooling ramp (Δt_thermal, s). Source: §8–9, SPEC_DEFAULT.
dt_thermal_seconds.title: Dt Thermal Seconds

plant_dt_thermal_seconds.description: Plant value for Δt_thermal. None = linked to dt_thermal_seconds. Set explicitly to simulate a plant/engine thermal-model divergence.
plant_dt_thermal_seconds.title: Plant Dt Thermal Seconds

alpha_max.description: Engine value: maximum cooling fraction (α_max). Source: §8, SPEC_DEFAULT.

grid_import_price_per_mwh.description: Grid import energy price for §21.2 cost accounting ($/MWh). None = use system default ($120/MWh wholesale spot fallback). Set to the all-in energy-charge line item for C&I utility tariffs.
grid_import_price_per_mwh.title: Grid Import Price Per Mwh

bess_charge_price_override_per_mwh.description: Override BESS charge price ($/MWh). None = derive from effective grid_import_price_per_mwh. Set only for sites with a separate contracted charging tariff.
bess_charge_price_override_per_mwh.title: Bess Charge Price Override Per Mwh
